landing.heroTitle: Write, Organize, Publish: Your Complete Writing Companion!
landing.heroDescription: Looking to unleash your creativity and bring your writing projects to life? Look no further than our Writing App! With our user-friendly platform, you can seamlessly organize all your writings in one place.
landing.quote: "The scariest moment is always just before you start." - Stephen King
landing.ctaTitle: Sign up to start using all the functionalities from our writing app!
landing.featureEditText: You will be able to edit your book with a bunch of different options in our built in - easy to use text editor.
landing.featureManageText: You can easily manage the order of your books by just dragging them around changing their order, renaming their titles or descriptions.
landing.featureExportText: When you finish writing your book you can click on the Generate Pdf section and this will generate a downloadable PDF for you to easily visualize your draft.

welcome.title: Welcome to the ultimate Writing App!
welcome.description: You are all set up. Start writing and see your analytics on this page!

chart.sessionDuration: Duration of each session in minutes

createBook.title: Create book
createBook.chaptersQuestion: Do you know how many chapters will your book have?

editBook.previewPdfDescription: Download a your PDF document from your book. Export it and previsualize it in your favorite device.

help.title: Writing Help
help.writingBasicsContent: Your work is auto-saved every 2 seconds. Select text to format it with the bubble toolbar. Type on an empty line and click + to add blocks like headings, lists, and images.
help.chapterManagementContent: Drag and drop chapters to reorder them. Click the pencil icon to rename titles and descriptions. Use the trash icon to delete chapters.
help.pdfExportContent: Click 'Preview PDF' on the book edit page to generate and download a PDF with all your chapters and formatting preserved.
